_comment: v5.3. The watcher scans every shop below for each bottle's match rules and alerts when a match is in stock between min_price and max_price. match_all = every term in the title; match_any = at least one; exclude = none. global_exclude is appended to every bottle's exclude list (bundles, combos, empties). gate_tags: a product carrying any of these Shopify tags is treated as not buyable (Liquor Barn keeps allocated bottles listed at MSRP with an 'unavailable' tag). Keep terms lowercase and apostrophe-free. ALWAYS live-test new rules against shop search before committing.

bottles.name: King of Kentucky (single barrel)
bottles._note: Brown-Forman single barrel, any year (2026 = 14yr, $399.99, Oct 2026). Small Batch (Feb 2026, $299) excluded.

bottles.name: George T. Stagg (GTS)
bottles._note: Annual BTAC release. 'batch' blocks the non-BTAC Stagg (ex-Stagg Jr) when shops prefix it with George T.

bottles.name: Jack Daniel's Coy Hill (2021 or 2024)
bottles._note: 2021 single barrel High Proof and 2024 Barrelhouse 8 (700ml). Excludes 2022, the 375ml Small Batch, and the 2026 Coy Hill Rye. Undated 'High Proof' listings can be 2021 or 2022 - check the label.

bottles.name: Mugen Nobunaga
bottles._note: Mugen Spirit Shogun Series, 15yr finished in Chichibu casks. Any Nobunaga barrel at/under cap.

bottles.name: William Heavenhill 19 (WHH19, 2025)
bottles._note: 12th Edition, 19yr, 138.2 proof. Wheat exclude blocks the Heaven Hill Heritage Collection 19yr Wheat.

bottles.name: 13th Colony Double Oaked
bottles._note: Thirteenth Colony (Americus, GA) Cask Strength Double Oaked, any batch; single-barrel Double Oaked picks also match. 'double oak' covers oak/oaked.

bottles.name: Jack Daniel's 14 Year (Batch 1 or 2)
bottles._note: Batch 1 (2025) and Batch 2 (2026). Batch 03 is already being listed - excluded. Undated listings match; check the batch on the label.
